name: pst-art-led
description: A LaTeX project to Print Dot Matrix LED Displays
scripts-doc: The scripts object contains custom shortcut commands that you can execute from your terminal using npm run <script-name>.
npm run latex: Uses make to compile .tex file into a PDF.
npm run latex n=3: Uses make to compile .tex file 3 times into a PDF.
npm run latexc: Uses make to clean generated files
npm run build: Uses latexmk to compile .tex file into a PDF. The -interaction=nonstopmode flag ensures the build won't freeze if it encounters a minor compilation error.
npm run watch: Keeps the compiler running in the background. It watches your files for changes and automatically re-compiles the PDF every time you save.
npm run clean: Cleans up temporary auxiliary files (like .aux, .log, .toc) generated during the compilation process.
npm run clean:all: Removes all auxiliary files plus the generated output PDF, giving you a completely fresh state.
npm run lint: Runs chktex (if installed on your system) to check your style, typos, and common formatting mistakes.
npm run format: Automatically fixes indentation and code alignment using latexindent.
npm run zipc: clean everything except .zip
